reason.temporary-support: It was only a temporary support.

hint.temporary-support: Sand and gravel fall: place the temporary support first and remove it later.
hint.scaffold: Some blocks are out of reach – build the temporary scaffolding first.

hint.observer-order: Place observers exactly in the given order so they do not fire too early.
hint.fluids-last: Water and lava come last so they don't flow into the build.
hint.look-direction: The direction of these blocks depends on where you look – follow the look direction exactly.
hint.interaction: Some blocks have to be right-clicked after placing (delay, mode).
